Transparent per-kilometre billing with verified clean sedans and spacious SUVs. Rates are calculated from our centralized pricing rules.

Help & Clarity

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear answers to frequent one-way drop taxi inquiries.

In a one-way trip, you are billed only for the kilometers driven from your pickup point to your drop destination (calculated using the selected vehicle's per-kilometre rate plus a fixed ₹400 driver bata per booking). You do not pay the return trip vehicle kilometer fare.
Highway toll fees, interstate border permits, and parking charges are not included in the base kilometer calculation. Customers pay tolls directly or compensate the driver against physical toll receipts to maintain complete transparency.
When you submit our booking wizard, an accurate trip summary is created and directed to our official WhatsApp (+91 9361974826). Our dispatch team acknowledges your request and provides the assigned driver and cab number.
Yes, Madurai Go Drop Taxi operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We provide direct pickups from Madurai Airport (IXM), Madurai Junction Railway Station, Mattuthavani Bus Stand, and doorstep residential pickups across all areas.
